p: made not this covenant with our: Some read, God made not this covenant, that is, in such ample forth and with such signs and wonders.
face to face in the mount: So plainly that you do not need to doubt it.
other gods before me: God binds us to serve him only without superstition and idolatry.
jealous God: That is, of his honour, not permitting it to be given to others.
love me and keep my commandments: The first degree to keep the commandments, is to love God.
thou shalt labour: Meaning, since God permits six days for our labours, we should willingly dedicate the seventh to serve him wholly.
Honour thy father and thy mother: Not for a show, but with true obedience, and due reverence.
thou desire thy neighbour's wife: He not only speaks of that resolute will, but that there should be no motion or affection.
added no more: Teaching us by his example to be content with his word, and add nothing to it.
that there were such an heart: He requires nothing but obedience from us, showing also that we ourselves are the unveiling of it.
turn aside to the right hand: You shall neither add nor take away, De 4:2.
live: In the same way that God, by way of our obedience, gives us all happiness: so from disobeying God proceed all our miseries.
